    uid=1_374 StaticText "Multiple select uses tags to display selected options."
    uid=1_375 StaticText "Set "
    uid=1_376 StaticText "multiple"
    uid=1_377 StaticText " attribute for "
    uid=1_378 StaticText "el-select"
    uid=1_379 StaticText " to enable multiple mode. In this case, the value of "
    uid=1_380 StaticText "v-model"
    uid=1_381 StaticText " will be an array of selected options. By default the selected options will be displayed as Tags. You can collapse them to a text by using "
    uid=1_382 StaticText "collapse-tags"
    uid=1_383 StaticText " attribute. You can check them when mouse hover collapse text by using "
    uid=1_384 StaticText "collapse-tags-tooltip"
    uid=1_385 StaticText " attribute."
    uid=1_386 StaticText "default"

    uid=1_1096 StaticText "Fallback Mechanism"
    uid=1_1097 StaticText "Properties in tag-tooltip follow this priority order:"
    uid=1_1098 StaticText "Explicitly defined fields within the tag-tooltip object."
    uid=1_1099 StaticText "Shared props inherited from el-select (e.g. effect, popper-class, popper-style, teleported, append-to, popper-options)."
    uid=1_1100 StaticText "Default values of the underlying el-tooltip component. This allows you to override specific tooltip behaviors for tags while maintaining consistency with the Select dropdown by default."
    uid=1_1101 StaticText "Custom Container Positioning"
    uid=1_1102 StaticText "When appending the Tooltip to a custom container (via the "
    uid=1_1103 StaticText "append-to"
    uid=1_1104 StaticText " attribute), the container should be configured with "
    uid=1_1105 StaticText "position: relative"
    uid=1_1106 StaticText " or "
    uid=1_1107 StaticText "position: absolute"
    uid=1_1108 StaticText " to ensure accurate positioning. Additionally, you can apply "
    uid=1_1109 StaticText "overflow: hidden"
    uid=1_1110 StaticText " to the container if you need to prevent the Tooltip from overflowing its boundaries."
